newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - Western Resources Inc Q2 net off.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Western Resources Inc Q2 net off.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Q2 1997 earnings applicable to common stock $23.1 million vs $25.4 million.

Q2 1997 net lower due to decreased sales as result of cooler weather patterns across its regulated electric and natural gas service territories. Revenues also lower due to reductions in regulated rates for electricity and extended outage at La Cygne Generating Station.

Q2 1997 also included pretax gain of about $11.5 million from sale of Hanover Compressor Co stock. Western sold about 2.1 million of its 5.2 million shares for $19.50 a share, generating net proceeds of $37.7 million.
